response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as share FROM status_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) as average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) as how_far_above_average FROM status_shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
